n1.speaker: monk
n1.text: You are awake. Good. Kneel, child.

n2.speaker: monk
n2.text: Eighteen winters ago I found you in the ash of a burned village. I gave you a name, a blade, a purpose. Do you remember what I asked in return?

choices.text: ...I remember the ash. Not much else.

n3.speaker: monk
n3.text: This temple sits at the centre of many pages. Every world you know has counterparts - other tellings of it, printed in other inks.

n4.speaker: monk
n4.text: A shore of woodblock waves. A city of smoke and lamplight. A metropolis of a thousand shimmering dots. Each one a reflection of ours.

n5.speaker: monk
n5.text: In each telling, someone hoards a light that is not theirs. Their greed is why our world grows dark. Bring their light home, and the balance returns.

n6.speaker: samurai
n6.text: And the people who hold these lights?

n7.speaker: monk
n7.text: ...Are dangerous. Do not listen to them. Their words are the sharpest thing they carry.

n8.speaker: monk
n8.text: Each world is sealed by a key. Find it, and the page will let you leave. I will speak to you from behind the page.

choices.text: Why do you always wear the mask, Master?

mask.speaker: monk
mask.text: Because my light would blind you, child.
mask.text_high_hope: ...Because some faces are not meant for children. Do not ask again.

n9.speaker: monk
n9.text: The gate is open. Mission one: The Order. Go.

repeat.speaker: monk
repeat.text: The gate is open. Why do you linger?
